pages.title: Three Shades of Tea
pages.text: One crop offers several processing stages.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find a tea plant and dry its leaves to the desired stages. JEI shows the transitions; one of each is enough.

pages.title: Grow tea
pages.text: Use Shears on suitable small flowers for Tea Blossom. Plant tea and harvest its leaves for further processing.

pages.title: Dry and ferment tea leaves
pages.text: Craft leaves into their leaf block and place it to dry. Starting block and processing stage determine Green, Oolong or Black Tea.
